tonight.headline: Flowers needs 36.8 tonight
body: Bad news first. Garrett Wilson's Week 11 quarterback is in doubt: Geno Smith left Sunday with a head/ankle issue and Cade Klubnik 'may have to start' against the Chargers, and Omar Cooper Jr. left on the first play with an ankle. Green Bay (your D/ST) and Cleveland (Boston) are on bye in Week 11, and Waddle's concussion has no update since 8 Nov.
The game: all nine of your starters are final at 136.94. Nicky Jam have only Zay Flowers left, in Baltimore-LA Chargers at 19:15 CDMX tonight, projected 14.6. ESPN gives you 99%. Nothing to set.

case.label: Their side
case.body: 100.16 banked. Flowers (BAL vs LAC, Monday 19:15 CDMX) is their only player left; Coker sits on their bench at 0.3.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Flowers scoring 37 or more — more than two and a half times his projection. Nothing on your side can move.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A rival adding the defence you want before Tuesday. Free agents can be taken by anyone at any time.

whatWentWrong.title: Boston is the first drop when a seat is needed
whatWentWrong.lead: 2 targets on a bad toe; the claim thesis is falsified, and Cleveland are on bye.

case.label: What happened
case.body: 1 catch on 2 targets while Watson threw for 300 (NBC 15 Nov). The thesis said under 5 targets with Watson would prove it wrong.

case.label: What it means
case.body: If Tuesday's D/ST add needs a roster spot, Boston (bye, toe) is the seat — not the Packers D/ST if you would rather keep them for Week 12, and never Wilson or Jefferson, whose teammates are out.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A clean toe report and 7+ targets in Week 12.
